readerCopy.body: Leadership insists the original plan is still intact while a public defection makes that claim impossible to maintain. One side defends continuity; the other names the rules, restrictions, or private decisions that made staying untenable. The Sun defends the official narrative, while Uranus gives the break from expectation a visible person and an undeniable consequence. The opposition puts institutional control across from the demand for independence in the same news cycle. The departure may free one person, but everyone left behind has to determine whether the system can survive the reason they walked away.
